I've always taken my poodles to Ivan Mazzocchi, and I can say without hesitation that he's one of the top professionals in the industry.
My dogs are like children to me, and nowadays it's truly rare to find someone to whom I can entrust my furry friends with complete peace of mind and security. With Ivan, however, I have this certainty: in addition to being extremely experienced and competent, he has an extraordinary understanding of canine language, a rare and precious quality.
His work is impeccable: from stripping to gland emptying, every treatment is performed with great professionalism, gentleness, and attention to the animal's well-being. He uses excellent grooming products and techniques resulting from ongoing professional development, certifications, and patents that demonstrate his expertise and passion for this work.
Furthermore, Ivan isn't just a great groomer: he's a true dog hairstylist. He manages to enhance every breed and every detail with taste, elegance, and great technical expertise, leaving my poodles always perfect.
Entrusting your dog to Ivan means placing it in the hands of a reliable, knowledgeable person who truly understands animals. I sincerely recommend him to anyone looking for a top-notch professional.
